connector.name: Semantic Scholar MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Semantic Scholar API: search 200M+ papers, citations, authors, recommendations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package s2-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the smaniches account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
